heroSection.headline: Brewing Community ,One Cup at a Time.
heroSection.subHeadline: We are a fiercely independent coffee roastery dedicated to ethical sourcing and the perfect roast.

ourStorySection.heading: Our Story
paragraphs: Founded in 2018 in a small garage with a 1kg roaster, Artisan Roasters was born out of a simple frustration: it was too hard to find coffee that tasted great and treated farmers fairly.

Today, we operate a zero-waste roastery and three cafes across the city. We travel the globe to build direct relationships with the families who grow our beans, paying well above fair-trade minimums to ensure sustainable livelihoods.

values.title: Sustainable Sourcing
values.description: We only partner with farms that practice shade-grown, regenerative agriculture to protect local ecosystems.

values.title: Small Batch Roasting
values.description: Every bean is roasted to order in small batches, ensuring you get the freshest cup possible.

values.title: Community First
values.description: From our farmers to our baristas to you, we believe coffee is a bridge that brings people together.
